title: Docker: images, applications and operating containers
summary: 42 detailed lessons from the first container to reproducible builds, Compose, networking, durable data, security, delivery and recovery. Study offline and use clearly scoped optional host labs.

lessons.title: Containers, images and the process model
lessons.outcome: Explain what evidence proves a web application is serving.
lessons.lab: Classify source code, image tag, container and volume.
lessons.verification: A running process plus a bounded HTTP request and expected response.

lessons.title: The Linux engine, WSL 2 and your first inspection
lessons.outcome: Explain a safe response to discovering a remote context.
lessons.verification: Stop before mutations and deliberately configure the owned local engine.

lessons.title: The filesystem, writable layers and container lifetime
lessons.outcome: Choose storage for user progress and transient scratch data.
lessons.verification: A named volume for progress and bounded temporary storage for scratch.

lessons.title: Processes, PID 1, signals and graceful shutdown
lessons.outcome: Design a shutdown acceptance check for a writer.
lessons.lab: Write a four-step graceful shutdown sequence.
lessons.verification: Bounded stop, consistent persisted record and restart recovery.

lessons.title: Dockerfile instructions and the first reproducible image
concepts: Dockerfile instructions and the first reproducible image
lessons.outcome: Define build and runtime acceptance separately.
lessons.lab: Write a minimal Dockerfile for a single file app.
lessons.verification: Build succeeds, then endpoint and writable data behavior pass.

lessons.title: Build context, .dockerignore and accidental data exposure
lessons.outcome: Describe source and image privacy acceptance.
lessons.lab: Design a context inventory for the fixture.
lessons.verification: Review inputs, build recipe and safe final file inventory.

lessons.title: Layers, cache invalidation and efficient rebuilds
lessons.outcome: Design a build-performance experiment.
lessons.lab: Reorder dependency metadata and app source conceptually.
lessons.verification: Same engine and context, one controlled edit, named cache observations.

lessons.title: Environment variables, command arguments and configuration
lessons.outcome: Write a public configuration evidence record.
lessons.lab: Design defaults and validation for a timeout variable.
lessons.verification: Name, safe synthetic value, source of override and observed response.

lessons.title: Ports, loopback and the first browser request
concepts: loopback and the first browser request
lessons.outcome: Choose public and internal endpoints for a two-service app.
lessons.lab: Draw a host browser request path.
lessons.verification: Only the user-facing service gets a deliberate published port.

lessons.title: Logs, exit status and observation before repair
concepts: exit status and observation before repair
lessons.outcome: Design log content for a public teaching server.
lessons.verification: Useful request metadata without tokens, raw secrets or private payloads.

lessons.title: Compose services, projects and a complete application
lessons.outcome: Design a two-copy experiment without interference.
lessons.lab: Write the project lifecycle command sequence.
lessons.verification: Distinct project names and distinct published host ports.

lessons.title: Health checks, startup order and real readiness
lessons.outcome: Write separate health and acceptance assertions.
lessons.lab: Design a readiness endpoint for a file-backed teaching app.
lessons.verification: Health endpoint succeeds; user-facing response and persistence also satisfy their contracts.

lessons.title: Named volumes, bind mounts and persistence experiments
lessons.outcome: Choose a safe cleanup policy for progress.
lessons.verification: Stop containers routinely; delete data only after an explicit reset decision.

lessons.title: First capstone: build, serve, replace and explain
lessons.outcome: Teach the project to a beginner without using hidden host state.
lessons.lab: Produce the complete build-and-request evidence packet.
lessons.verification: A fresh-copy procedure with prerequisites, expected outputs and scoped cleanup.

lessons.title: BuildKit, cache mounts and build secrets
lessons.outcome: Describe a dependency acquisition policy.
lessons.verification: Locked inputs, deliberate network access and no default private credentials.

lessons.title: Multi-stage builds and runtime dependency boundaries
concepts: Multi-stage builds and runtime dependency boundaries
lessons.outcome: Specify final-image acceptance.
lessons.verification: Run the exact final image under intended user, mounts and network.

lessons.title: CPU architectures, image indexes and cross-platform builds
lessons.outcome: Write an honest portability claim.
lessons.verification: Name the tested platform and label other platforms unqualified.

lessons.title: Bridge networks, service DNS and container-to-container traffic
lessons.outcome: Design an internal-only database connection.
lessons.verification: Use service DNS and container port without host publication.

lessons.title: Network isolation, gateways and outbound connectivity
lessons.outcome: Define outbound acceptance for an offline worker.
lessons.verification: Prepared local computation succeeds and no external fetch is required.

lessons.title: Users, UID ownership and writable data paths
concepts: UID ownership and writable data paths
lessons.outcome: Write a permission acceptance check.
lessons.lab: Design a non-root image setup sequence.
lessons.verification: Non-root process can write data and cannot mutate packaged code.

lessons.title: Backups, restores and proving data recovery
lessons.outcome: Produce a recovery evidence packet.
lessons.verification: Source identity, export hash, restore target, parsed value and cleanup record.

lessons.title: Resource limits, contention and honest performance experiments
lessons.outcome: Define a safe resource stress boundary.
lessons.verification: Small fixed workload, timeout and owned disposable target.

lessons.title: Read-only filesystems, capabilities and least privilege
lessons.outcome: Review a hardening change without overstating security.
lessons.verification: State controls tested and the trusted-local-code boundary.

lessons.title: Rootless engines, user namespaces and host trust
lessons.outcome: State a support claim for a new rootless setup.
lessons.verification: Actual app build, network, storage and cleanup observations.

lessons.title: Image names, digests and an offline transfer
lessons.outcome: Define offline acceptance for the study app.
lessons.verification: Imported image starts with local data and no required external services.

lessons.title: Compose overrides, profiles and configuration review
lessons.outcome: Write a reviewable configuration launch record.
lessons.lab: Create an override for a public message.
lessons.verification: Ordered files, profiles, project name and safe resolved settings.

lessons.title: Intermediate capstone: a recoverable two-tier teaching system
lessons.outcome: Write a beginner operator handoff.
lessons.verification: Setup, evidence, failure diagnosis, backup/restore and scoped cleanup.

lessons.title: Registries, tags, digests and deliberate publication
lessons.outcome: Describe a safe publication review without performing it.
lessons.verification: Explicit destination, visibility, immutable artifact and rollback plan.

lessons.title: Software bills of materials and image provenance
concepts: Software bills of materials and image provenance
lessons.outcome: Write a supply-chain review for the fixture.
lessons.verification: Known source, resolved base, component record and actual acceptance limits.

lessons.title: Vulnerability findings, patching and dependency updates
lessons.outcome: Write a patch decision record.
lessons.verification: Finding, affected artifact, chosen action, tests and residual risk.

lessons.title: CI builds, test layers and artifact promotion
lessons.outcome: Write a release gate with honest limitations.
lessons.verification: Named actual checks on exact artifacts, plus visible skipped surfaces.

lessons.title: Debugging minimal images without changing the contract
concepts: Debugging minimal images without changing the contract
lessons.outcome: Write a repeatable minimal-image incident procedure.
lessons.verification: Preserve artifact, inspect state, run bounded prepared probes and test a source repair.

lessons.title: Restart policies, failure loops and idempotent startup
lessons.outcome: Define restart acceptance for a stateful app.
lessons.verification: Repeated starts preserve valid data and expose unrecoverable failures clearly.

lessons.title: Application migrations and durable state versioning
concepts: Application migrations and durable state versioning
lessons.outcome: Write a migration release plan.
lessons.lab: Design a v1-to-v2 synthetic record conversion.
lessons.verification: Preconditions, backup, transition, validation, compatible rollback and cleanup.

lessons.title: Image size, startup latency and measurement
lessons.outcome: Write an optimization recommendation with evidence.
lessons.verification: Measured bottleneck, bounded change, correctness recheck and actual improvement.

lessons.title: Compose on one host and the limits of orchestration
concepts: Compose on one host and the limits of orchestration
lessons.outcome: Choose an orchestration approach for a stated workload.
lessons.verification: A reasoned choice based on availability, scaling, operations and learning cost.

lessons.title: TLS, reverse proxies and publishing responsibly
lessons.outcome: State what would be required before public exposure.
lessons.lab: Draw proxy and upstream trust boundaries.
lessons.verification: A separate deployment design covering access, TLS, limits, operations and data.

lessons.title: Incident response, disk pressure and scoped cleanup
lessons.outcome: Write a scoped recovery and cleanup plan.
lessons.verification: Explicit targets, retained data, repair check and final ownership readback.

lessons.title: Namespaces, cgroups, OCI and the runtime beneath Docker
concepts: OCI and the runtime beneath Docker
lessons.outcome: Describe the shared-kernel security implication.
lessons.verification: Least privilege and patching remain necessary parts of the trust model.

lessons.title: Runtime secrets, configuration files and controlled disclosure
lessons.outcome: Write a secret data-flow review.
lessons.verification: Source, host protection, service grant, read path, logs, rotation and deletion.

lessons.title: Scaling replicas, shared state and concurrency traps
lessons.outcome: Propose a correct scaled counter architecture.
lessons.verification: A transaction-capable shared store or explicit single-writer ownership.

lessons.title: Advanced capstone: a release, recovery and teaching handoff
lessons.outcome: Teach the full system and defend its limits.
lessons.verification: A beginner can follow the handoff and identify what it does not guarantee.
